INSERT IGNORE INTO user_block (blocker_id, blocked_id, create_time) VALUES (#{blockerId}, #{blockedId}, NOW())

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_follow f1 WHERE f1.follower_id = #{userId} AND f1.followee_id = u.id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_follow f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = u.id AND f2.followee_id = #{userId} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_block b WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{userId} AND b.blocked_id = u.id) OR (b.blocker_id = u.id AND b.blocked_id = #{userId}) )
